dedupe_keys.name: everest ev charging and simulation stack

description: EVerest is an LF Energy project initiated by PIONIX for modular electric-vehicle charging software. Its MQTT-connected modules cover charging protocols, energy management and hardware interfaces. The documented software-in-the-loop configuration replaces power meters, RFID readers and vehicles with simulated modules, allowing a charging session to be controlled through Node-RED. Inputs are module connections, configuration and charging actions; outputs include charging states and module messages. Spatial coverage is the configured station or experiment, and event timing follows its modules. Source is free under Apache-2.0 with C++, Python and Rust extension interfaces. A limitation is that the administration panel and parts of its documentation are changing; simulated hardware behaviour does not establish physical charger compliance. EVerest supports controller and protocol testing for charging-infrastructure simulations. evcc (platform-evcc) provides related charging-control software. No container or installer was downloaded.
